property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array and any callee address, C.transfer always successfully calls the target function with the correct selector so the call returns true (no revert); the mutant with a wrong selector will make that external call fail for at least some real contract callees, causing transfer to revert — so the reference never reverts for any valid inputs while the mutant can revert for some inputs.
change_summary: Change the selector to transferFrom(address,address,uint256) to transferFrom(address,address,uint256) with different bytes4 (mistyped) by using keccak256("transferFrom(address,address,uint256)") with an extra space to alter the selector, causing external calls to likely fail and change return behavior.
